svg.title: Final stack and development roadmap
svg.desc: Confirmed tech stack and 6-phase build order for Electric Bus Tracker

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me Phase 1 setup: Node.js + MongoDB + Railway deployment step by step')
g.text: Init Node.js project · Connect MongoDB Atlas · Deploy to Railway
Build REST API skeleton · Setup GitHub repo + GitHub Actions CI/CD

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me Phase 2: Firebase Auth + JWT integration in Node.js and Flutter')
g.text: Firebase Auth setup · Driver + Admin login screens in Flutter
Role-based access · JWT tokens · Password reset · Account lockout

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me Phase 3: Ably.io real-time GPS tracking with Flutter and Node.js')
g.text: Ably.io channels setup · Driver GPS publish every 5 sec
Passenger map subscribes live · Upstash Redis stores locations

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me Phase 4: Google Maps Flutter integration + EAT calculation')
g.text: Google Maps in Flutter · Draw bus routes · Show all stops
EAT algorithm · Search routes + schedules · Favorite routes

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me Phase 5: Admin panel and Driver duty management screens in Flutter')
g.text: Phase 5 — Admin panel + driver duty system
Admin: manage buses, routes, drivers, schedules
Driver: view duties, start/end duty, auto-complete on arrival

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me Phase 6: PDF reports, notifications and final testing for production')
g.text: Testing all 77 requirements · Play Store submission · Go live!

svg.text: Click any phase to start building it — code + instructions ready
Total: $0 during dev · ~$120/month when national launch
